description: This file defines the RoleRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide database access methods for Role entities, including a custom method to find roles by name.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Role entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom method to find a Role by its name.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Role entity by its name, returning an Optional<Role>.
